AstroBotany · Analysis

Does measured light/dark metabolism support a carbon-starvation model of plant spaceflight?

A model of the BRIC-LED-001 flight (OSD-522) predicted that microgravity starves lit plants of carbon, so lit spaceflight transcriptomes should look carbon-starved and dark ones should not. It could not check its metabolite predictions, because NASA's Open Science Data Repository holds no plant metabolome. Here hundreds of natural Arabidopsis accessions, measured in light and after darkness, supply the missing metabolism, and six flight experiments test the light/dark claim under predictions committed in advance.

02The model's predictions against measured darkness

The first study predicted 21 compounds. Darkness can test the $nScored driven by the carbon deficit.

$nModelAgree agree in direction: maltose falls, and asparagine, valine, leucine and isoleucine rise. Glutamate, which the model raises with them, falls ($gluWu log2, $gluWuFrac % of accessions). Glutamine does not move, and $nModelUntested predictions have no light/dark measurement. The model gives the six starvation amino acids one shared fold change, but leucine responds $ratioLeuAsn–$ratioLeuVal times as strongly as valine or asparagine. It also leaves out $nNotPredictedRobust robust responses, among them malate ($malZhu) and 2-oxoglutarate ($oxgZhu), both TCA-cycle acids whose direction it judged uncertain.

03PaintOmics with a measured metabolite layerground reference, not flight data

Same OSD-522 genes and proteins; the 21 predicted compounds replaced by $nLayer measured ones.

The pathway result did not move: the same $nPathA of $nPathTotal pathways pass a false discovery rate of 0.05, led by protein processing in the endoplasmic reticulum, and the rank correlation of all pathway p-values is $rhoOneA. Leucine, valine, isoleucine and glutamate stay metabolite hubs, and malate, 2-oxoglutarate, glutathione and ascorbate join them. The raw hub p-value is identical for every compound the two jobs share ($nSharedHubSteps compound-steps): a hub is set by the differentially expressed genes around it, so the metabolite layer contributes its compound list, not its values.

04Light and dark flight in the same hardware

OSD-678 grew Col-0 seedlings in the same CARA plates on the same flight, in the cabin's ambient light (4–6 µmol m−2 s−1) or wrapped in black-out cloth from germination.

The light contrast had $ratioDE times as many differentially expressed genes ($nDELight against $nDEDark) and more significant pathways ($nPathB against $nPathC). The branched-chain amino acids, glutamate and 2-oxoglutarate were hubs only in light, the direction the model expects, but every light hub sat just inside the threshold (FDR $hubLightFDR) and the light contrast had far more genes to place around them. Photosynthesis was the most significant pathway in the dark contrast.

05Pre-registered light/dark tests

Six gene sets and their predicted outcomes, committed before any test ran (prereg/PREDICTIONS.md).

The model predicts a starvation signal in lit flight and none in dark flight. Of $nTests outcomes $nMatch matched, but none of the predicted lit signals passed correction: the carbon-starvation (DIN) set leaned up in all three lit contrasts (OSD-522 p $pDinFiveTwoTwo). The first study's Mann–Whitney test gave p $pDinFirstStudy for OSD-522, and is reproduced here; a permutation of the twelve samples, which keeps the correlation between genes, weakens it. The strongest signals came from dark flights: DIN and branched-chain amino acid catabolism fell in BRIC-PDFU seedlings (OSD-321, q $qDinThreeTwoOne) and rose in the leaves of dark-grown CARA seedlings (OSD-678 dark, q $qDinDark). Gene sets from the natural-variation GWAS loci showed nothing light-specific.

06What a targeted GC-MS panel would need

Replicate variance from $nPanelGroups Col-0 control groups in $nPanelStudies MetaboLights GC-MS studies.

With six plants per arm, as in OSD-522's RNA-seq, the smallest detectable change is $detectMin log2 ($detectMinFold-fold), for sucrose. The model's predicted 0.13 log2 shift would need $nQThousandMin to $nQThousandMax plants per arm, and its shift at OSD-522's own growth light at least $nQSixtyMin. A two-fold change, the scale of the measured darkness responses, needs at most $nTwoFoldMax.

07A dark sealed BRIC with a proteome (OSD-38)

BRIC-20: Col-0 seedlings grown about three days in darkness on 1 % sucrose, in sealed BRIC-PDFU canisters on the station and on the ground, with RNA-seq and iTRAQ membrane and soluble proteomes (Kruse et al. 2020). Tested under a second pre-registration (prereg/osd38).

OSDR's processed protein tables are truncated at $nOsdRows rows, the old spreadsheet limit. The membrane table's first block survives whole ($nProtMem proteins); only the top-ranked $nProtSol soluble proteins remain. Quantified with the paper's rules, the membrane layer gives $nPaperRule proteins at the paper's threshold, against the 103 it reports.

All four KEGG carbon pathways rose in the transcriptome but fell in the membrane proteome (q from $qMemCarbonMin to $qMemCarbonMax), and that held against abundance-matched random protein sets. Branched-chain amino acid degradation did not move at either level. On the ground, the BRIC-PDFU against a closed container showed no hypoxia or fermentation signal. In PaintOmics, OSD-38's genes and proteins share only $nPathAD significant pathway with OSD-522's lit canister, but $nHubAD metabolite hubs, including leucine, isoleucine and glutamate: the hubs the first study read as lit-canister starvation appear in the dark too.

Methods and limits

The darkness reference is a far larger perturbation than the model's 9 % assimilation deficit, so it fixes directions, not flight magnitudes. A source counted for a compound when at least 75 % of accessions moved the same way (Zhu, Wu) or at Welch p < 0.05 (Caldana). Compound names were matched to KEGG through its REST API and every correction is recorded with the KEGG name that confirms it. The Caldana genotype is not stated in the sources read here, and Wu's stress condition is taken from its supplement. The five flight contrasts other than OSD-522 were tested against a genomic-rotation null, which is weaker than a sample permutation. OSD-678's light arm was ambient cabin light of 4–6 µmol m−2 s−1, well below OSD-522's 60, so it is a weak test of the model's light dependence. PaintOmics hub counts rise with the number of differentially expressed genes. The GC-MS variance pools leaf and shoot studies from different laboratories. OSDR's OSD-38 protein tables are truncated, so the soluble layer is a top-ranked subset; iTRAQ compresses ratios, which shrinks protein changes but should not reverse them; OSD-38 has three replicates per arm, and its BRIC-versus-container comparison also differs in site and handling. The pre-registration was written by the same analyst on the day of the tests, after the reference was built; the commit order shows that no prediction or setting changed after a flight result was seen.
